svg.title: Archili Tskipuridze — cybersecurity, GRC, and software engineering
svg.desc: A unified visual portfolio for Archili Tskipuridze. Featured: Aegis GRC, Threadforge, Threadnote, ThreadVoice. Thread ecosystem: Threadforge Mobile, ThreadCalendar, Threadplan, ThreadMail, ThreadStorage, Threadshot, ThreadAura, Threadlendar Dock, ThreadSpace. Security: Aegis Helpdesk, Aegis Website. Utilities: AI Usage for Stream Deck, WoW Control, iOS Simulator for Windows. Thread OS is at the research and planning stage. Most repositories are private. Application logos are embedded from the assets referenced by the current project interfaces, with the original technology-logo toolbox restored. The dark technical HUD design uses angled frames, circular terminals, branching connector lines, and dot-matrix details. A neutral black-and-white foundation is accented by Threadforge-inspired orange and blue light on rotating rings, moving circuits, small card corners, and pulsing terminals. The code portrait is slightly smaller. Decorative HUD motion respects reduced-motion preferences.

g.text: From verifiable trust to everyday workflows.
TURNING SECURITY CLAIMS INTO VERIFIABLE EVIDENCE.
Security platforms and tools I am building for everyday work.
Desktop apps, Android companions, and a shared workspace hub.
Offline tasks and habits with reminders
A local unified inbox with provider
with pinned apps, files, and folders.
A workspace hub for agents, skills, memory, routines, and desktop tools.
Controls tied to evidence. Risks tied to owners. Traceable decisions.
Small tools for the workflows around the main workspace.
and a runtime for web apps.
A planned Debian / KDE development environment with a Thread Hub workspace.
TOOLS CHANGE. THE REQUIREMENT FOR TRUSTWORTHY EVIDENCE DOES NOT.
Security is the shortest trustworthy path
